info.name: CFO Customer API
info.description: Shopper app endpoints. Set {{base_url}}, sign in, and paste the token into {{token}}. Reference: docs/customer-api.md

query.description: Six digits. `checked: false` means no courier could be asked — not that the answer was no.

request.description: The whole basket, priced — plus selected_address (the address strip) and available_coupon_count (how many rows cart.coupons returns).

Applies a code. 422 when the basket is under the minimum spend, and also when the code would take nothing off — a free-shipping coupon on a basket that already ships free. The response carries coupon.discount, coupon.shipping_discount and coupon.savings; savings is the figure to quote to the shopper.
Every live code judged against this basket: discount, shipping_discount, savings, usable and the reason it is not. The row count is what GET /cart returns as available_coupon_count.

The review screen. Passing address_id chooses that address and remembers it on the basket, so GET /cart shows the same one. Answers with selected_address, display-ready shipping options (price_label, eta_label, note) and payment methods carrying icon.

query.description: Optional. Choosing one remembers it on the basket.

request.description: Puts an old order's lines back in the basket. Always 200: `added[]` says what went in (with status added/partial and a warning), `skipped[]` says what could not and why, and `cart` is the full GET /cart payload.
A signed, seven-day URL to the order's printable HTML invoice. The URL itself needs no token.
The invoice document. Reached with the signature from orders.invoice rather than a bearer token — paste the whole url it returned.
Opens a Razorpay order for an order whose `payment_required` is true. Repeating it returns the attempt already open.
Settles the payment from what Razorpay Checkout handed the app. A signature that does not match is 422.
Razorpay's own callback. Public, and believed only with a valid X-Razorpay-Signature header (HMAC of the raw body under RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET). No bearer token.
